_doc: SMILESCAPE DENTAL CLINIC — Design Tokens (source of truth). Consumed by web/tailwind.config.mjs. Per EYWA DR-029 (Universal Brand Design System) + DR-EYWA-MKT-005 (Astro stack profile).
_status: LOCKED 2026-06-06 — 'Bridge' direction. Derived from the existing brand's official system colors (smilescapeclinic.com: soft periwinkle #7BA4DD logo blue + coral #EE9C9C + vivid #217DEA) bridged toward the operator's premium reference (DENTAL LEAD ads: deeper navy hero). Keeps the warm, approachable identity ('คลินิกที่ทุกคนสบายใจ') while reserving navy depth for hero / Blue Diamond moments. Font confirmed: Noto Sans Thai. Spacing / radius / breakpoint / motion = universal defaults.
_workflow: Edit this file → npm run build in web/ → tokens propagate to Tailwind config → components use via Tailwind classes (e.g., bg-brand-primary, text-brand-anchor, bg-brand-paper).

color._status: LOCKED 2026-06-06 (Bridge). primary #217DEA = official accent promoted to the action role (CTA/links). highlight #7BA4DD = official primary (logo periwinkle) kept for soft brand emphasis. accent #EE9C9C = official secondary coral — the sanctioned WARM human-touch pop (this brand intentionally keeps warmth, unlike a pure-clinical system). anchor #14386B = navy for hero/footer/dark sections. Surfaces are cool: paper #F5FAFE → ice #EAF3FB → primary-soft #D8E6F3.

anchor._desc: LOCKED — Medium-deep navy. Hero, footer, dark sections, premium 'Blue Diamond' moments. Bridges the existing royal blue toward the premium reference without going fully black-navy.

primary._desc: LOCKED — Vivid clinical blue (existing site's official accent). Primary action color: CTAs, links, active states, wordmark.

primary-deep._desc: LOCKED — Hover/active state for primary buttons and links.

primary-soft._desc: LOCKED — Light blue tint. Card backgrounds, chips, price cards.

highlight._desc: LOCKED — Soft periwinkle = the brand LOGO color (official 'primary'). Soft emphasis, secondary/quiet buttons, brand-soft fills, inline highlight.

ice._desc: LOCKED — Ultralight blue. Section-alternate surface, sits between paper and primary-soft to give the page rhythm.

paper._desc: LOCKED — Airy cool off-white (existing site background). Main page surface. Cool blue-tinted, NOT warm cream.

accent._desc: LOCKED — Soft coral (official 'secondary'). The single sanctioned WARM pop: human-touch moments, friendly checkmarks/badges, care/comfort signals. Use sparingly against the blues.

900._desc: LOCKED — Brand ink (existing site's official Text color). Used for body copy + strong dark text. Note: a true-neutral gray, paired with the cool slate ramp above for muted text/borders.

text-on-paper._desc: text on paper — use anchor (navy) for readability

typography._status: LOCKED 2026-06-07 — Type system (per operator/Dr. Ham). Body + UI = Google Sans for BOTH Latin and Thai (Google Fonts 2025 public release, open license; subsets latin/latin-ext/thai self-hosted in public/fonts/google-sans). Display/headings = Cabinet Grotesk (Fontshare ITF Free License, self-hosted; also on the existing site), with Google Sans as its Thai fallback. Earlier Noto Sans Thai + DM Sans both removed.

display._desc: Headings / hero (Latin). Self-hosted from Fontshare (public/fonts/cabinet-grotesk, weights 400/500/700/800). Thai falls back to Google Sans. Tailwind class: font-display.

sans.value: 'Google Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif
sans._desc: Body + UI for Latin AND Thai. Self-hosted (public/fonts/google-sans, weights 400/500/600/700, subsets latin/latin-ext/thai). Tailwind default font-sans.

mono._desc: Code blocks, technical specs. System-mono — no custom font load.

scale._doc: Modular scale 1.25 (major third). Adjust if brand identity calls for different rhythm.

relaxed._desc: long-form TH body text reads better with relaxed

spacing._doc: Base unit 4px. Use semantic spacing in components, not raw values.

full._desc: pill buttons — matches existing site CTA style

shadow._doc: Soft, clean shadows tinted with the brand navy — a clinic site should feel calm, hygienic, trustworthy.

pattern._status: SKELETON — brand signature mark / decorative patterns TBD in brand session. Not consumed by Tailwind (decorative only).

sparkle._desc: Placeholder 'clean & healthy' sparkle mark. Embed inline SVG in components; color via currentColor.

sparkle._usage: Hero accent, badge embellishment. Color via currentColor.

motion._doc: Calm, reassuring motion — clinic audiences want clarity and ease, not flashy movement.
